decisions.reason: As a low-cost, close-to-core Magento add-on, the template still functions as a small option on shop-related demand and there is too little evidence after only its launch year to justify abandoning it.

A responsive website template fits the firm’s existing hosting and agency customer base, likely costs little to keep available, and its market potential is still too uncertain after a short time to close the option.

Premium customer support is tightly aligned with the firm’s service strengths and recurring revenue model, so keeping it open is attractive while demand and willingness to pay are still being learned.

The software version management tool builds directly on the firm’s technical capabilities and platform strategy, and its dedicated presentation suggests enough strategic importance to continue developing rather than abandon early.

The data-processing-contract tool is comparatively distant from the core hosting business, likely requires ongoing non-core maintenance and compliance attention, and with several stronger adjacent options the firm would rationally redeploy resources away from it.
